text:
Sara CSM: quick weekly health check — throwing up the error-rate breakdown for accounts we flagged. overall error share increased: 5xx spike on Tue, timeouts ticked up during biz hours, rate-limit blips for batch embeddings. dashboard: <https://redwood.internal/dash/acct-health-1798|weekly acct health>

Maria (CS): saw the Parcelize onboarding flows hit hard. key symptom: multipart uploads -> backend 503s. customer reports retries piling up. :worried:

Jon D: dropping raw breakdown from sampling window (Mon 00:00 → Sun 23:59):
```
5xx (all accounts): 12.4% of error events (peak Tue 03:15 UTC)
timeouts: 3.6% (mainly /v1/chat/stream)
rate_limit: 1.8% (burst on /v1/embeddings/batch)
```
Top failing endpoints (by 5xx count):
```
/v1/generate                1,234 5xx   432 timeouts
/v1/chat/stream              320 5xx   120 timeouts
/v1/embeddings/batch        210 rate_limit  80 5xx
/accounts/onboard            95 5xx  (auth err)
```

Kev I: checked infra logs for the Tue window — upstream model-host g17 returned overload 503s, queueing high. small snippet:
```
[2026-03-18T03:15:12Z] ERROR upstream 503 from host g17-12: grpc: server overload - queue len=512
[2026-03-18T03:15:18Z] WARN  concurrent_workers=120 > target=80 for pool g17
```

Maria (CS): Parcelize (acct #P-442) accounts for ~48% of /v1/generate 5xxs during the spike — they were running bulk upload jobs.

Sara CSM: action items:
- Jon D -> open CS ticket + attach sampling/trace to Parcelize (due EOD Fri)
- Kev I -> temporarily reduce concurrency / increase backoff on g17 pool and enable jitter (in-progress)
- Maria -> notify Parcelize with mitigation steps and ask to stagger bulk jobs

Jon D: ticket created: CS-4589 with traces + single-request replay. pinging @Kev I for config change. :white_check_mark:

Kev I: applied reduced concurrency (target 60%) and bumped retry jitter. I also suppressed the noisy alert for g17 for 2h while we observe. will post metrics in 30m.

InfraBot: Alert suppression applied by Kev I for resource g17 until 2026-03-18T06:00:00Z. Reference: A-9021

Sara CSM: thanks all. Maria, include the customer note draft here and I'll sign off. we'll re-evaluate next check-in and escalate to eng-runtime if 5xxs don't fall by 50% after mitigation.
